statement: Set K0 = 275. For every nonempty finite set X, every r ∈ (0, 1), and every family D ⊆ 2X with µr(D) ≥ 1 − 1/K0, the family EK0 (D) = {S ⊆ X : S ̸⊆ D1 ∪ · · · ∪ DK0 for every D1, . . . , DK0 ∈ D} has a cover of cost at most 1/2 at the same parameter r. The family D need not be monotone, and members of a tuple may repeat.
